quote.translation: The foregoing has shown, as a matter of course, that there are two different principles by which a system of Modality can be constructed.

quote.translation: Following this first method of construction, the system of Modality presents the combinations (1) the actual and the non-actual, (2) the possible and the impossible, (3) the necessary and the contingent, and we may think of the opposition of the actual and the non-actual as the case in which "existence" is placed as subject and the predicate affirms or denies it directly.

regions.text: 第二の構成原理は主語の否定にある。すなはち相矛盾する主語に同一の述を措定する。

quote.translation: The second principle of construction lies in the negation of the subject: one and the same predicate is posited of mutually contradictory subjects.

quote.translation: To affirm existence as possible is the possible in the narrow sense, and to affirm non-existence as possible is the contingent.
